# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Ats nundenáby', utsen Dios, ku Mets xhacópy' nexhcipet ya tóon myáky. Mets xhpudéque ku ngyáku-ti yàk-jápulu. Mets ats yáku jápul tóon uts ayóh mets muk kayamanan.
Ats xwútsu7h-kwúkwpi7 tlu7 tsukw ha7wí, ta Sknúxwatip, tatá7a sentsukwmína ta7 wa7áx tlu7 tsukw ha7wí.
